name: merge the two least probable symbols into a tree
mechanism: repeatedly join the two least probable symbols into a node whose probability is their sum until one tree remains; the path to each leaf is its code, so frequent symbols get short codes and no code is a prefix of another

sources.ref: List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Huffman coding' in section Information theory and signal processing / Coding theory / Lossless compression algorithms: simple lossless compression taking advantage of relative character frequencies
List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Adaptive Huffman coding': adaptive coding technique based on Huffman coding
List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Package-merge algorithm': Optimizes Huffman coding subject to a length restriction on code strings

fails_when: whole-bit code lengths lose against arithmetic coding on skewed sources
the table must be known to the decoder
